topic: The Moon Race: USSR vs US
thesis: The Moon Race was a Cold War contest of engineering, propaganda, and national will in which the Soviet Union led early milestones while the United States achieved the decisive lunar landing.

findings.claim: The Moon Race grew out of Cold War military rocketry
findings.evidence_summary: Intercontinental missiles made orbital flight technically feasible

findings.claim: The USSR scored the first satellite and first human orbit
findings.evidence_summary: Sputnik and Gagarin demonstrated early Soviet momentum

findings.claim: Kennedy's 1961 pledge reframed US goals toward the Moon
findings.evidence_summary: Apollo became a concentrated national engineering project

findings.claim: Robotic precursors reduced risk before crewed landings
findings.evidence_summary: Luna, Ranger, and Surveyor mapped hazards and surfaces

findings.claim: Apollo 11 fulfilled the US lunar landing before a Soviet equivalent
findings.evidence_summary: Armstrong and Aldrin walked the Moon in July 1969

findings.claim: Both sides used space achievements for propaganda
findings.evidence_summary: Success was sold as proof of system superiority

findings.claim: Crash programs demanded unprecedented coordination and budget
findings.evidence_summary: Thousands of contractors and civil servants worked under deadlines

findings.claim: The race ended in cooperation as much as competition
findings.evidence_summary: Apollo-Soyuz and later ISS linked former rivals

open_questions: Could the USSR have landed cosmonauts if funding priorities had differed?
How much of Apollo's success depended on political deadline pressure?
